key_insight: The paper introduces a training-free video editing framework that can modify objects, actions, and dynamic interactions in real-world videos—enabling complex content and motion changes without collecting new training data or fine-tuning models.
problem_solved: Existing methods either require costly specialized training or are limited to structure- and motion-preserving edits; this work addresses the challenge of performing versatile, semantically meaningful video edits (including changing actions and dynamics) without additional training data.
method: Training-free pipeline that decomposes a video into appearance, motion, and interaction components and applies edits by re-synthesizing frames guided by pretrained generative priors and motion cues.

Edit operations include insertion/replacement of objects, action modification, and dynamic interactions by combining image/video generative models with optical-flow-based temporal propagation and region-aware blending to preserve consistency.
No model fine-tuning: relies on optimization and model-guided priors at inference time to produce temporally coherent edited videos across diverse real-world scenes.
impact: Enables flexible, realistic video edits for creative production, VFX, and data augmentation without expensive labeled datasets or retraining—lowering the barrier for practitioners to manipulate high-level behaviors and dynamics in videos.
visual_elements: Before/after frame triptych showing original video, localized edit (e.g., object/action change), and synthesized result to illustrate semantic change.
Pipeline diagram (decomposition → edit via generative prior → motion propagation → blending) to explain the training-free workflow.
Motion/flow visualization overlay (arrows or color-coded flow) to show how temporal consistency and dynamic changes are handled.
Icon set emphasizing 'no training' (e.g., crossed-out training loop), creative edits (magic wand), and temporal coherence (timeline with consistent frames).
paper_title: Versatile Editing of Video Content, Actions, and Dynamics without Training
paper_authors: Vladimir Kulikov, Roni Paiss, Andrey Voynov, Inbar Mosseri, Tali Dekel
